t: This JG Speedfit 15mm emergency shut-off tap provides a reliable solution for isolating water flow in plumbing systems. Its robust plastic construction ensures durability and is suitable for both hot and cold water applications, handling temperatures up to 65ºC. The convenient push-fit system allows for quick and secure installation, making it ideal for plumbers and heating engineers working on domestic or commercial projects. Being demountable, it offers flexibility for future maintenance or modifications. This essential valve helps manage water supply efficiently.
b: Reliable Emergency Shut-Off Tap for 15mm Pipes
Suitable Hot & Cold Water up to 65°C
Essential Valve for Plumbing & Heating Systems
